g.text: SN11 cabin NTC 10k on a local flying lead

g.desc: SN11 cabin NTC 10k on a local flying lead

g.text: Every part in this box but U13 and C38 is DNP; each carries its reason in its Note field. Nothing here touches +12V_CMF; U14 and the GND / PGND rule (CONVENTIONS 5) hold.

g.desc: Every part in this box but U13 and C38 is DNP; each carries its reason in its Note field. Nothing here touches +12V_CMF; U14 and the GND / PGND rule (CONVENTIONS 5) hold.

g.text: U13 second expander TCA9539-Q1 at 0x75 (A0 high, A1 low) - FITTED: P00 SEAT_STATUS (moved from U12 P17), P01 the radar alert

g.desc: U13 second expander TCA9539-Q1 at 0x75 (A0 high, A1 low) - FITTED: P00 SEAT_STATUS (moved from U12 P17), P01 the radar alert

g.text: - Window coil current (K5-K8) and the logic-12 V budget on F22 3 A: 2 coils + one mirror + logic is about 2.2 A.

g.desc: - Window coil current (K5-K8) and the logic-12 V budget on F22 3 A: 2 coils + one mirror + logic is about 2.2 A.

g.text: - The two PROFET IS lines (U9, U10) are not read: all 42 Teensy edge pins are used. Diagnostics stay off (DEN low), and so on the clutch stage U14 (Y11).

g.desc: - The two PROFET IS lines (U9, U10) are not read: all 42 Teensy edge pins are used. Diagnostics stay off (DEN low), and so on the clutch stage U14 (Y11).

g.text: SN14 blower PWM >= 20 kHz to the final stage at L3-BLW

g.desc: SN14 blower PWM >= 20 kHz to the final stage at L3-BLW

g.text: - The enclosure: V-102 is unmeasured, so the board outline is PROVISIONAL (180 x 80 mm, four M3; sized by the three DT13 flanges) - confirm.

g.desc: - The enclosure: V-102 is unmeasured, so the board outline is PROVISIONAL (180 x 80 mm, four M3; sized by the three DT13 flanges) - confirm.

g.text: - TPS54560B compensation, RT and inductor: proposals from the datasheet method, not checked in WEBENCH.

g.desc: - TPS54560B compensation, RT and inductor: proposals from the datasheet method, not checked in WEBENCH.

g.text: - The wake strip input level: drawn as a 12 V high-side source into a diode-OR strip (D-350); SN21 still confirm.

g.desc: - The wake strip input level: drawn as a 12 V high-side source into a diode-OR strip (D-350); SN21 still confirm.

g.text: SN17 mirror drive: DRV8962-Q1 on its 44 real pins - 3 half-bridges + channel 4 low FET as the clutch sink, IN4 tied low (D-360); MODE low = 140 ns edges, OCPM low = latch-off (an nSLEEP pulse clears it), VCC tied to DVDD; fed from logic 12 V

g.desc: SN17 mirror drive: DRV8962-Q1 on its 44 real pins - 3 half-bridges + channel 4 low FET as the clutch sink, IN4 tied low (D-360); MODE low = 140 ns edges, OCPM low = latch-off (an nSLEEP pulse clears it), VCC tied to DVDD; fed from logic 12 V

g.text: Same I2C bus as U12 (R51 / R52). INT wired-OR on EXP_INT (both open-drain, one pull-up R53, Teensy 12); RESET shared on EXP_RESET (R54 holds both in reset):

g.desc: Same I2C bus as U12 (R51 / R52). INT wired-OR on EXP_INT (both open-drain, one pull-up R53, Teensy 12); RESET shared on EXP_RESET (R54 holds both in reset):

g.text: one pin left on the Teensy for neither, and a reset must leave every output stage off on both expanders at once. P02-P17 unused: firmware sets them outputs, low.

g.desc: one pin left on the Teensy for neither, and a reset must leave every output stage off on both expanders at once. P02-P17 unused: firmware sets them outputs, low.

g.text: SN16 seat heat driver - the four BTS3011TE STATUS pins (open-drain, latched thermal fault) are wired-OR on SEAT_STATUS to expander U13 P00 through R58 (Y11)

g.desc: SN16 seat heat driver - the four BTS3011TE STATUS pins (open-drain, latched thermal fault) are wired-OR on SEAT_STATUS to expander U13 P00 through R58 (Y11)

g.text: - BTS3011TE STATUS x4 wired-OR to U13 P00 with one 10k pull-up: a latched thermal fault reads low; clearing it needs P00 driven high (3-7 mA per faulted part) with IN low - confirm the expander's drive.

g.desc: - BTS3011TE STATUS x4 wired-OR to U13 P00 with one 10k pull-up: a latched thermal fault reads low; clearing it needs P00 driven high (3-7 mA per faulted part) with IN low - confirm the expander's drive.

g.text: an open-collector output needs R68 fitted and reads low when it alerts. 12 V -> 3.8 V clamped by D11; 8 V still reads high (VIH 2.31 V at 3.3 V). J12 is a PLACEHOLDER - confirm.

g.desc: an open-collector output needs R68 fitted and reads low when it alerts. 12 V -> 3.8 V clamped by D11; 8 V still reads high (VIH 2.31 V at 3.3 V). J12 is a PLACEHOLDER - confirm.

g.text: RADAR ALERT luxury 03.12 / Z-002 - DNP: J12 the receiver's alert lead -> 47k / 22k, 100n, BAT54S -> U13 P01; R68 wets an open-collector output

g.desc: RADAR ALERT luxury 03.12 / Z-002 - DNP: J12 the receiver's alert lead -> 47k / 22k, 100n, BAT54S -> U13 P01; R68 wets an open-collector output

g.text: NO-CONNECTS: TPS54560B EN floats high on its internal pull-up; U13 P03-P17 and U15 ALERT/RDY are unused. DP-DCU-B 12 (AC_CLUTCH) and DP-DCU-C 8 (PGND) are wired for blocks 02.15 / 01.26 (Y11).

g.desc: NO-CONNECTS: TPS54560B EN floats high on its internal pull-up; U13 P03-P17 and U15 ALERT/RDY are unused. DP-DCU-B 12 (AC_CLUTCH) and DP-DCU-C 8 (PGND) are wired for blocks 02.15 / 01.26 (Y11).

g.text: the copper is there either way, the contact and its 14 AWG wire are fitted with the answer. DP-DCU-B 12 carries AC_CLUTCH (02.15 (b)); it stays a plug until then.

g.text: A/C PRESSURE block 02.15 (b) - DNP: J11 transducer lead (0.5-4.5 V ratiometric, confirm) -> 10k / 20k -> U15 ADS1115-Q1 at 0x48; its 5 V from U16, which tracks +5V

g.text: No Teensy ADC pin is free (all 42 edge pins used, D-452), so the reading goes over I2C. AIN0 pressure, AIN2 the sensor supply (ratio = AIN0 / AIN2); AIN1 and AIN3 grounded, spare.

g.desc: No Teensy ADC pin is free (all 42 edge pins used, D-452), so the reading goes over I2C. AIN0 pressure, AIN2 the sensor supply (ratio = AIN0 / AIN2); AIN1 and AIN3 grounded, spare.
